title: Tool surface consolidation — the free merges (37 → ~31)
description:
Merges that are safe on structural grounds alone (no usage data needed — each removes a redundant entry point to an answer another tool already gives; zero capability lost). Analysis from 2026-07-10 session: the real cost of 37 tools is not schema tokens (Claude Code defers MCP schemas) but selection cost — overlapping answers to the same question in the navigation hot path.

Merge 1 — workspace admin (4 → 1): sutra_add_root ("register + force reparse"), sutra_status ("register + return status"), sutra_parse ("trigger reparse"), sutra_tools (tier enable/disable) → single sutra_workspace(workspace, action: status|reparse, tiers?: {...}). status remains the default action. −3 tools.

Merge 2 — find + resolve → explore (7 → 5 in nav): sutra_explore already falls through to exact lookup for qualified names (subsumes sutra_find's main case); sutra_resolve's aliases.toml lookup becomes explore's FIRST ranked tier (alias hit → top result with fetch instruction). Keep sutra_grep (literal patterns are a distinct query), sutra_read, sutra_map, sutra_outline. −2 tools.

Merge 3 — duplicates → similar: sutra_duplicates is sutra_similar with no target (same HRR machinery). Make symbol optional: present → similar-to-X, absent → all near-dupe pairs. −1 tool.

Explicitly OUT of scope (do NOT merge): refs/calls/trace/impact (distinct answers sharing plumbing — mode-enum mega-tools get worse descriptions and more misuse, not less; revisit only after sutra_context usage data exists); dead/hotspots/winnow and pr_risk/diff_impact (debatable — gated on telemetry, see the pruning review task).

Cleanup obligations (part of this task, not follow-ups):
- Update every doc/instruction that names removed tools: sutra CLAUDE.md exploration protocol, ~/soft/manas CLAUDE.md sutra_mcp section, docs/agents/*, sutra_help recipes, MCP server instructions string (v0.9.0 lists all 37 names).
- Removed names should NOT linger as hidden aliases — agents relearn from list_tools; a clean break with updated descriptions beats a compat shim nobody removes.
- Contract discipline (L9): sutra_status output shape is consumed by agents ("run sutra_status first") — the merged tool's default action must preserve its response contract or docs must be updated in the same change.
execution_record: Executed as planned with minor deviations: (1) Landed at 32 tools not 31 — the original count was 38 not 37 (the server info string auto-counts from the router map). Net -6 tools. (2) Used Arc<WorkspaceEntry> in sutra_workspace to avoid clone-guard violations from the spawn_blocking pattern. (3) CLI `sutra find` subcommand kept as-is — it calls tools::find::handle directly, which remains a valid internal function. The find and resolve tool modules stay compiled but are no longer registered as MCP tools. (4) Also updated all diagnostic suggestion strings across 8 files (calls, refs, trace, impact, read, context, provenance, guard) that referenced removed tool names. (5) manas-cli instructions updated in a separate commit in that repo, including a new sutra_context pointer."
